plain: A cross, stubborn habit of opposing what others want

webster.text: Disposition to cross or vex; untractableness; crossness of temper; a disposition uncomplying, unaccommodating or acting in opposition to what is proper or what is desired by others.

example.quote: But this untractableness may be carried too far, and may degenerate into obstinacy, perverseness, or disingenuity.
